decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (TCP - 01, Syon Gate - Car Park Management Plan, Transport Statement 001, Site - 01, Site - 02. Received 05/09/2016
224956/55. Received 24/11/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - Within two months of permission being granted a Car Park Management Plan including the following measures is to be submitted to The Local Planning Authority for approval: 
"	  Details of measures to ensure the car park will be managed and operated in such a way to ensure there is no queuing back onto Northumberland Avenue
"	  Details of measures to advise Sky staff that the car park is full including location of any signage
"	  Details of measures to ensure the car park will be managed and operated in such a way to prevent un-necessary turns into Northumberland Avenue and that turning vehicles do not block southbound vehicles on Syon Lane
"	  A management plan setting out how the management and operation of the car park will be monitored, issues identified and how any issues or problems that arise will be rectified
"	  Details of a monitoring regime
"	  Timescales for implementation of measures to rectify identified issues
Condition : 3 - The car park shall only operate between the hours of 7am to 9pm Monday to Friday and no more than 130 vehicles shall be parked on site at any one time.

Condition : 4 - The use of the site as a car park shall cease on the 30th September 2017 and all related apparatus and facilities associated with the use shall be removed from site within one calendar month of the cessation date unless otherwise agreed in advance in writing by the Council and the boundaries of the site shall be secured by hoarding as present at the time of submission of the application to which this decision relates, or such other means as shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition of the existing brick walls at the site shall take place unless agreed in advance in writing by the local planning authority by the submission of an application for planning permission, including details of the proposed replacement boundary treatment.
description: Use as temporary car park until 30 September 2017
